newsitem.title: FRANCE: ADP to present 1996 global results and outlook.
newsitem.headline: ADP to present 1996 global results and outlook.

text.p: The Paris airports authority, Aeroports de Paris (ADP), said it will present its 1996 passenger and freight traffic results at a press conference on March 12 1997.

The conference, to be given by ADP's chairman, Jean Fleury and general manager, Emmanuel Duret, will also focus on Federal Express' decision to locate its European hub at Charles de Gaulle airport which was the main air cargo development at the ADP in 1996.
This year will see the completion of an extension to the Sogaris freight centre and new warehousing and office facilities for Japanese forwarding group, Nippon Express.
ADP 1996 cargo traffic rose 1.1 percent from 1995 levels reaching 1,112,500 tonnes. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
